meaning:
Salem = "peace"
the place of which Melchizedek was king
most Jewish commentators affirm that it is the same as Jerusalem
Another name of ye.ru.sha.laim (יְרוּשָׁלִַ֫ם, יְרוּשְׁלֵם "Jerusalem" H3389)

elsewhere.note: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
